caption_used: The pie chart delineates the distribution of subtasks within the MMRA benchmark, comprising 11 distinct categories. The 'ObservationAngle' segment, depicted in bright green, constitutes 12.28% of the total, while 'SimilarMaterial,' shown in orange, accounts for approximately 10.33%. Notably, the 'SubEvent' category, represented in rose, appears to have surged to 11.45%, marginally exceeding 'UsageSimilarity,' which stabilizes at 9.65%. The 'Environment,' 'Layout,' 'SimilarEvent,' and 'AppearanceSimilarity' segments each represent roughly 8.77% of the dataset, with 'MentalitySimilarity' closely trailing at 8.12%. The 'RelativePosition' slice, colored in gray, comprises 7.90%, whereas 'NearSameEntity,' in dark gray, demonstrates a modest decline, representing only 5.89% of the benchmark. The chart employs percentage labels within each segment for enhanced clarity and omits a separate legend, ensuring an uncluttered visual representation.
